The Dishes

A one-minute DOYOURWORK ad, with narration. Turn the sound on.

Press play with the sound on.
0:00 / 1:05

The idea: parents get a way to say it once, and kids stop getting asked to do what they were already going to do. Everyone picks today's chores on one shared phone or tablet; dares come in as the bonus once everyone has their own phone. The swear is never heard: a passing car's horn covers it. The full script with timings is in launch/marketing/dishes-ad-script.md in the repo.
